question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

One day, the queen was painting when a messenger entered ________ to convey the king's arrival.
solution: The correct answer is: **breathlessly** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • **Comparably **means in a way that is similar in size, amount, or quality to something else. (एक तरह से जो किसी चीज़ के आकार, मात्रा या गुणवत्ता के समान हो) • **Relatively **means in relation, comparison, or proportion to something else. (किसी चीज के संबंध, तुलना या अनुपात में) • **Enjoyably **means in a way that gives delight or pleasure. (एक तरह से जो आनंद या आनंद देता है) • **Breathlessly **means in a way that is characterized by great excitement or suspense. (एक तरह से जो बहुत उत्साह या रहस्य की विशेषता है) • The implied meaning of the sentence is: A courier rushed in to announce the king's coming one day as the queen was painting. • So, as per the meaning of the given words "**breathlessly**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Therefore, the correct answer is option 4. Complete sentence:* One day, the queen was painting when a messenger entered **breathlessly __**to convey the king's arrival. * 3a:T711, The correct answer is: **No error**
